source: v14 validated database, global grammar stem deduplication, original v15 grammar polish set

features.grammarDedup: Globally normalized question stems; retained one best-complete record per stem.
features.readingTranslation: Full passage translation appears only after answering the final question of a passage.
features.readingTimer: Each passage has a target reading time and a pauseable count-up stopwatch.
features.learningAnalytics: Local progress analytics show actual mistakes, level accuracy, coverage, and review-risk candidates.
features.examples: Each vocabulary word and idiom has a semantically tailored one-sentence usage example.
